why: issues 1598 + 1232 -- one SPAWNED sched task's RTOS task memory (control block + stack) as a named `.bss` static the ENTRY owns, sized from the sched task's declared `stack_bytes`. `nros::main!` emits one per spawned sched task for a board whose sched task runner creates the task over it (FreeRTOS `xTaskCreateStatic`; Zephyr `k_thread_create` over the stack, TCB region 0). Same no-allocator constraint as `rust:SchedTaskExecutorBacking`: on an RTOS the task stack came out of a fixed allocator arena nothing priced at link. rclrs runs on host threads and has no sched task model. Covers `SchedTaskMemory::new` (const, `.bss`) and `SchedTaskMemory::raw` (the row a board receives).
